entries.english:
A: Dieter “Hilprant,” provincial judge in the County of Hirschberg
S: Hirschberg Provincial Court (Eichstätt district)
E: Abbess Agnes von Leonrod and the community of Seligenporten Abbey

Subject: Court charter confirming as the free property of Seligenporten Abbey the following possessions situated in the County of Hirschberg, each individually listed: the abbey church at Seligenporten; the village of “Kutenhausen” (Kittenhausen, Neumarkt district in Upper Palatinate); the village of “Pabsenspach” (Pavelsbach, Neumarkt district), “Oberdorff” (the upper village in Pavelsbach), and “Eysperch” (Asbach, Neumarkt district); Birkenlach (Neumarkt district); at Möning (Neumarkt district), the “Telczenhoff,” the farm held by the Pöllinger, the farm held by Hermann “Dyetrer,” the farm held by the “Dürmair,” the farm held by the “Ländrer,” two farmsteads there, the “Rewthöffe” (Richthof, Neumarkt district) held by the “Strobl,” and the farm held by the “Vederlein”; at Aßlschwang (Neumarkt district), the holding occupied by Hermann “Plensär,” the farm held by the “Vesman,” and the holding held by the “Nadlär”; at Rohr (Roth district), the holding held by the “Gesmötz”; at “Ebenrewt” (Ebenried, Roth district), the holding held by the “Plikendrat” and the holding there held by the “Kutzhawpt”; at Mörsdorf (Neumarkt district), the “Stainhoff,” the holding held by the “Widenman,” the holding held by the “Smidel,” the holding held by the son of the “Plensär,” and the holding held by the “Vnger”; at “Jostorff” (Jahrsdorf, Roth district), the holding held by the “Grübel”; the holding at “Wäczleinshoff” (Waizenhofen, Roth district, or a place deserted near Jahrsdorf) held by the “Hutzelmair”; at Pyras (Roth district), the holding held by the “Kornmair”; at Eysölden (Roth district), the holding held by the “Hübner” and the holding held by Ottel “Mair”; at “Stetn” (Stetten, Roth district), the holding held by the “Goglär”; at Thalmässing (Roth district), the holding held by the “Widenman,” as well as the upper church and its tithe; at Alfershausen (Roth district), the church, tithe, the parish endowment holding occupied by the “Widman,” and the holding occupied by the “Spillär”; at Stetten (Roth district), the fields in the arable and two patches of meadow formerly held from the abbey by the “Lundelmair,” and the holding occupied by Ullein “Mair”; at Steinbach (Nuremberg Land district), the “Loterhof,” held by the “Wolfflein,” and three holdings held by the “Matzner,” the “Vorster,” and the “Telling”; at Heuberg (Roth district), the church, tithe, and three holdings occupied by the “Pütel,” his brother-in-law, and the “Gräter”; at “Eysprehtzstorf” (Eismannsdorf, Roth district), the holding held by the “Kurcz”; at “Harlach” (Harrlach, Roth district), the holding occupied by the “Vogelsängerin”; at “Hartzhoff” (Harrhof, Roth district), the holding occupied by the “Rül” and the “Koller”; at “Hännpach” (Oberhembach, possibly Neumarkt district), the holding occupied by the “Hümel” and the “Igelfritz”; at “Kesselpach” (Köstlbach, Neumarkt district), five holdings occupied by the “Prenner,” the “Mair,” Markel “Mair,” the “Räwschel,” and the “Hannhödel”; at Pölling (Neumarkt district), the parish, tithe, and eight holdings occupied by Fritz “Hainholt,” the “Widenman,” the “Snabel,” the “Angrär,” the “Harbsleben,” the “Koblär,” the “Selfliez,” and the “Gütlär”; at Holzheim (Neumarkt district), the holding occupied by Markel “Mair,” together with the farmsteads and tithes; at Tyrolsberg (Neumarkt district), four holdings occupied by the “Rascher,” the “Zeidlär,” and the two “Lurtzer,” as well as the tithe; at Winnberg (Neumarkt district), three holdings occupied by the “Gäwtner,” the “Herdlär,” and the “Albrecht”; at Tauernfeld (Neumarkt district), the holding occupied by the “Fuzsel”; at Leutenbach (Neumarkt district), the holding occupied by the “Smidel”; at “Yschoffen” (Ischhofen, Neumarkt district), the holding occupied by the “Aichelperger”; the holding at Mittersthal (Neumarkt district) occupied by the “Velser”; six holdings at Kleinalfalterbach (Neumarkt district) occupied by the “Meinerstorfer,” the “Vischer,” Wernher’s son, Ullein “Mair,” the “Polster,” and the “Lantzhhuter”; three holdings at “Pahtzhawsen” (Batzhausen, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Krappenhofer,” the “Strobel,” and the “Hotter”; three holdings at “Pircheich” (Pirkach, Neumarkt district), occupied by Götz’s son, the “Veter,” and the “Kagrär”; the holding at “Hawsn” (Hausen, Roth district) occupied by the “Grufenmair”; the holding at Ittelhofen (Neumarkt district), cultivated by the “Stahel”; the holding at “Keffenhul” (Kevenhüll, Eichstätt district), cultivated by the “Kastner”; the holding at “Heinspergch,” occupied by the “Chüttelmair”; two holdings with their associated farmsteads at Pfraundorf (Eichstätt district), occupied by the “Kolman,” the “Halpmair,” and the “Sneider”; the farm at “Kunerstorf” (Körnersdorf, Neumarkt district), held by the “Erlacher”; the mill at “Almerstorf” (Ellmannsdorf, Neumarkt district); the holding at Frettenshofen (Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Zeitzlär”; the holding at “Weipperstorf” (Wappersdorf, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Mair”; the holding at Wangen (Neumarkt district), occupied by Ulrich; the holding at “Winnerzhofen” (Winterzhofen, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Kekel”; the holding at “Hernsperg” (Herrnsberg, Roth district), occupied by the “Stokel”; the holding at “Riblingen” (Rübling, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Roslein”; the holding at “Käwssingen” (Kaising, Roth district), occupied by the “Hindermair”; the holding at Landerzhofen (Roth district), occupied by the “Schaffer”; five holdings at Weidenwang (Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Mair,” the “Ressel,” the “Streb,” the “Huter,” and Perchtold’s son; the castle site at Hohenweidenwang; the holding at [Groß-]Berghausen (Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Wernher”; the holding at Kleinberghausen (Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Schrampawmer”; four holdings at “Obernrewt” (Obernricht, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Chastner,” Fritz “Sighart,” the “May,” and the “Pesolt”; six holdings at Forchheim (Neumarkt district), occupied by “Mulherman,” the “Sneider,” the “Krawtzer,” the “Lewhtzner,” the “Hullär,” and the “Vederlein”; the holding at Ohausen (Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Sneyder”; the holding at “Kawrhoff,” occupied by the “Seitz”; the “Schawrhoff,” occupied by the “Roll”; the mill and pond at “Rükertzstetn” (Reckenstetten, Roth district); the mill and pond at “Thennenloch” (Dennenlohe, Neumarkt district); two farms at “Thännleinsperg” (Dillberg, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Freitag” and the “Ketzlär”; two holdings at Hausheim (Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Silberär” and the “Stewb”; two holdings at Riebling (Neumarkt district), cultivated from the abbey by the “Henger”; the holding at “Rewthaim” (Richtheim, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Rugwaitz”; the holding at “Almanshofn” (Allershofen, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Rudel”; the holding at Günching (Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Awer”; the holding at “Sweiber” (Freischweibach, Amberg-Sulzbach district), occupied by the “Swebhawbt”; the holding at “Wesenaker” (Ober-/Unterwiesenacker, Neumarkt district), occupied by the “Turigel”;
